stem.text: Cocoa butter contains three different triglycerides. These triglycerides are made from the fatty acids:
The three triglycerides found in cocoa butter are POS, SOS and POP.
The chemical structure of the triglyceride POS is shown next to a diagrammatic representation of POS.

stem.alt: Displayed structural formula of a triglyceride drawn as three rows of carbon chains joined to a vertical glycerol backbone.
Diagram of three boxes labelled P, O and S joined to a vertical column labelled GLYCEROL.

A.text: Triglyceride POP contains two unsaturated fatty acids joined by ester bonds to glycerol.

B.text: Triglyceride POS contains two less carbon atoms than triglyceride POP.

C.text: Triglyceride SOS contains four more carbon atoms than triglyceride POP.

D.text: Triglyceride SOS contains two saturated fatty acids joined by hydrolysis to glycerol.
